ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $\angle AOC : \angle BOC = 1 : 5$. OD is the angle bisector of $\angle AOB$, and $\angle COD = 36^\circ$. What is the degree measure of $\angle AOC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle AOC : \angle BOC = 1 : 5$,\\
let $\angle AOC = x$, then $\angle BOC = 5x$,\\
thus $\angle AOB = \angle AOC + \angle BOC = x + 5x = 6x$,\\
since OD bisects $\angle AOB$,\\
thus $\angle AOD = \frac{1}{2} \angle AOB = 3x$,\\
thus $\angle COD = \angle AOD - \angle AOC$,\\
thus $3x - x = 36^\circ$,\\
solving this gives $x = 18^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle AOC = \boxed{18^\circ}$.
